name: Marseille
tagline: France's oldest city, gritty and sunny on the sea
summary: Marseille is France's oldest city and its great Mediterranean port: noisy, multicultural and full of light. Climb to Notre-Dame de la Garde, wander the Panier quarter, eat bouillabaisse at the Old Port and hike to white limestone calanques.
seasonNote: Summer is hot; calanques may close in high fire risk. The mistral wind can blow cold in winter and spring.
arrival: Trains from Paris take about 3 hours 20; Marseille Provence Airport has shuttle buses to Saint-Charles station.
gettingAround: Metro, trams and buses; boats to the Frioul islands and calanques.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; small cash helps at markets and bakeries.
foodTip: Bouillabaisse, panisse chickpea fries and navette biscuits.
buyTip: Savon de Marseille soap and santons figurines.
